description: This PHP source file is responsible for setting up and displaying the mail scanner information interface within the vtiger CRM system. It loads necessary dependencies, initializes Smarty templating, assigns variables, retrieves list of mail scanners, and renders the template.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty templating class instance used for rendering the UI.

classes.name: Vtiger_MailScannerInfo
classes.description: Class responsible for retrieving mail scanner configurations.

classes.name: Vtiger_Cron
classes.description: Class managing scheduled cron tasks, used here to get the mail scanner cron instance.

methods.name: listAll
methods.description: Retrieves the list of all mail scanners configured.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides an instance of the specified cron task, in this case 'MailScanner'.
